mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO reminder_push_record (record_type,send_status,scheduled_at,node_code,business_sn,receiver_key,error_code,error_message,skip_key) VALUES
(3,0,#{row.scheduledAt},#{row.nodeCode},#{row.businessSn},#{row.receiverKey}, #{row.errorCode},#{row.errorMessage},#{row.skipKey})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE error_message=VALUES(error_message),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select:
SELECT t.view_token FROM reminder_todo t WHERE t.assignee_userid=#{userid} AND t.status=0 AND t.view_token IS NOT NULL AND t.view_token<>'' AND t.node_code
= <>
'PACKING_RELATE'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reminder_todo other WHERE other.view_token=t.view_token AND other.node_code<>'PACKING_RELATE')
ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO reminder_todo (node_code,business_type,business_sn,item_key,round_key,entered_at,assignee_userid,status,view_token) VALUES
(#{row.nodeCode},#{row.businessType},#{row.businessSn},#{row.itemKey},#{row.roundKey}, #{row.enteredAt},#{row.assigneeUserid},0,#{row.viewToken})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE entered_at=VALUES(entered_at),status=0,view_token=VALUES(view_token)
mapper.update:
UPDATE reminder_todo SET view_token=#{token} WHERE assignee_userid=#{userid} AND status=0 AND node_code
= <>
'PACKING_RELATE'
mapper.select: SELECT d.todo_id AS todo_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.send_status=2 THEN b.id END) AS successes, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN b.send_status=2 THEN d.reminder_stage END),0) AS highest_stage, MAX(CASE WHEN b.scheduled_at=#{scheduledAt} AND b.send_status IN (1,2,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slot_blocked, MAX(CASE WHEN b.send_status IN (1,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unresolved, MAX(CASE WHEN b.send_status IN (0,3) AND b.next_retry_at IS NOT NULL AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(b.send_result,'$.expiresAt'))>#{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retry_pending FROM reminder_push_record d JOIN reminder_push_record b ON b.id=d.parent_id WHERE d.record_type=2 AND b.record_type=1 AND d.todo_id IN #{id} GROUP BY d.todo_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reminder_push_record original JOIN reminder_todo t ON t.id=original.todo_id WHERE original.parent_id=#{batchId} AND original.record_type=2 AND t.node_code='GOODS_READY' AND ( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) FROM reminder_push_record d JOIN reminder_push_record b ON b.id=d.parent_id WHERE d.record_type=2 AND b.record_type=1 AND b.send_status=2 AND d.todo_id=t.id) >= 2 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reminder_push_record d JOIN reminder_push_record b ON b.id=d.parent_id WHERE d.record_type=2 AND b.record_type=1 AND b.send_status=2 AND d.todo_id=t.id AND d.reminder_stage >= original.reminder_stage) )
mapper.update: UPDATE reminder_push_record SET next_retry_at=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type=1 AND send_status IN (0,3)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM reminder_push_record WHERE record_type=1 AND send_status=1 AND COALESCE(sent_at,updated_at,created_at)<=#{before} AND ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE reminder_push_record SET send_status=4,next_retry_at=NULL, send_result=JSON_SET(CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(send_result)='OBJECT' THEN send_result ELSE JSON_OBJECT('originalContext',send_result) END, '$.outcome',CAST(#{outcomeJson} AS JSON)) WHERE id=#{id} AND record_type=1 AND send_status=1 AND COALESCE(sent_at,updated_at,created_at)<=#{before} AND
mapper.select: SELECT id,send_result AS context_json FROM reminder_push_record WHERE record_type=1 AND send_status IN (0,3) AND next_retry_at<=#{now} AND ORDER BY next_retry_at,id LIMIT 20

SELECT t.business_sn,t.item_key,t.round_key,d.reminder_stage AS stage,t.node_code FROM reminder_push_record d JOIN reminder_todo t ON t.id=d.todo_id WHERE d.parent_id=#{id} AND d.record_type=2 AND t.status=0 AND t.assignee_userid=#{userid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reminder_push_record WHERE parent_id=#{id} AND record_type=2
SELECT assignee_userid FROM reminder_todo WHERE view_token=#{token} LIMIT 1
SELECT MIN(first_viewed_at) AS first_viewed_at, MAX(last_viewed_at) AS last_viewed_at, MAX(view_count) AS view_count FROM reminder_todo WHERE view_token=#{token}

SELECT t.id,t.node_code,t.business_type,t.business_sn,t.entered_at, COALESCE(p.cnt,0) AS reminder_count,p.first_at AS first_reminded_at FROM reminder_todo t LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.todo_id,COUNT(*) AS cnt,MIN(b.sent_at) AS first_at FROM reminder_push_record d JOIN reminder_push_record b ON b.id=d.parent_id AND b.record_type=1 WHERE d.record_type=2 AND b.send_status=2 GROUP BY d.todo_id) p ON p.todo_id=t.id WHERE t.view_token=#{token} AND t.status=0 ORDER BY t.node_code,t.entered_at,t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminder_reason_history (todo_id,reason,author_userid) SELECT id,#{reason},assignee_userid FROM reminder_todo WHERE id=#{todoId} AND view_token=#{token} AND status=0
